metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mam/apps/internal/67004 on the 26.4 lab tenant (UEM 26.4), 2026-09-24, recaptured live via InternalAppsV1Service.GetInternalAppByIdAsync (pkg-install variant). Genuine 26.4 recapture replacing the PORTED-FROM-26.2 fixture at this path.
